title: Kazuhiko Sano
description: Kazuhiko Sano submitted this brilliant poster concept (front, collection of William Plumb) for RETURN OF THE JEDI. Sano, who started as an advertising illustrator in Japan, has done other trilogy art (card 73). A search of the Skywalker Ranch archives finds other unused—and mostly unattributed—-poster concepts such as this mystical portrait of Luke under a REVENGE logo (back).
